items.title: Ninth woman's body found as South African police investigate string of deaths
items.dek: South Africa police have cautioned against assuming that all the killings are linked but many women are afraid.

items.title: Klopp wants to 'reclaim' flag amid German elections
items.dek: New Germany coach Jurgen Klopp says his team can help ensure "national pride is not entrusted to the wrong people" after a recent far-right election victory.
